sql:
SELECT ((p1.overall_rating - p2.overall_rating) / p1.overall_rating * 100) AS percentage_difference
FROM Player_Attributes AS p1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS p2 ON p1.date = p2.date AND p1.player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan') AND p2.player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Jordan Bowery')
WHERE p1.date = '2013-07-12'
